card.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
card.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we move the sofa: are we shrinking while the room stays normal, or is the room growing while we stay normal?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shrinking means call full-sized help. Growing means hurry before the door gets farther away. Choose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're shrinking. I'll call my brother.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him to bring tweezers. He'll need to collect us afterward.

mechanism: A requires B to choose between incompatible size explanations so a furniture move can follow one practical response.
confusable: Unlike solving a mystery privately, A must obtain B's choice and let it govern the next action.
comparison: Choosing shrinking leads to full-sized help and tweezers; the buffet scene chooses delayed rather than absent gravity.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
